name: ze_Cu6_AEI
title: Cu6 @ AEI
description: Cu6 cluster in the pear-shaped aei cage (8-ring windows, 3.8 A) of a frozen all-silica AEI (SSZ-39) framework (NEP89-relaxed conventional cell, 144 atoms); Cu-SSZ-39 is a hydrothermally stable NH3-SCR deNOx catalyst (Moliner et al., Chem. Commun. 48, 8264 (2012)) in which Cu can agglomerate into clusters. Framework Al, ionic/oxidic Cu and framework relaxation are not modelled, NEP89 binds Cu atoms to the cage wall (Cu-O ~2.1 A, Cu-Si ~2.4 A) and places this framework 6.7 kJ/mol SiO2 below alpha-quartz (calorimetry: all-silica zeolites lie ~7-14 kJ/mol above), so the global minimum is a model-PES optimum.
